name: Owen Roberts International Airport

runway.v: one runway 08/26, 2,398 m x 45 m, asphalt grooved; landing thresholds displaced (08 by 265 m, 26 by 124 m)

hours.v: ATS, AIS, fuel and handling 07:00-21:00 local (1200-0200 UTC); security H24; airport administration Mon-Fri 08:30-17:00

curfew.v: outside 21:00-07:00 local only medevacs and delayed commercial air transport, up to 23:59 local, with prior approval from aocc@caymanairports.com; other non-scheduled flights outside hours only after prior approval
curfew.quote: Out of hours operations are restricted to Medevacs and delayed commercial air transport operators up to 23:59 LST

customs.v: customs Mon-Fri printed as 1330-0400 UTC (0830-1100 LST) - the two do not match (1330-0400 UTC is 08:30-23:00 local); Sat 08:30-16:30 local (1330-2130 UTC); on request outside hours for a charge; Sun and holidays special attendance charges all day. Immigration daily printed 1200-2300 UTC (0700-2130 LST), on request outside hours

slots.v: all flights except locally based general aviation need slot approval; non-scheduled operators submit slots through their nominated handling agent
slots.quote: Non-scheduled operators can submit slots through their nominated handling agent.

handling.v: a nominated handling agent based at the airport is mandatory for all visiting aircraft, including diversions
handling.quote: A nominated handling agent is mandatory for all visiting aircraft

fuel.v: Jet A1 and Avgas 100LL; no aviation oils
fuel.quote: Jet A1, AVGAS 100 LL, no aviation oils available.

noise.v: no flights below 1,500 ft within 2,000 ft of the coast except take-off and landing; take-off from RWY 08 unless wind requires 26; between 0000-1200 UTC (19:00-07:00 local) climb on runway heading to 3,000 ft; no turns to final over George Town
noise.quote: Flights below 1500 FT, within 2000 FT of the coastline are prohibited, except for take-off and landing.

notes: Read: Cayman Islands AIP Aerodrome section, Civil Aviation Authority, pages dated 28 NOV 2024 (AMDT 01/2024) and 19 MAR 2026 (AMDT 01/2026), published on caymanairports.com (file 'Aerodrome-Mar-19-2026-version-1'). The customs and immigration lines print UTC and local times that do not agree; confirm with the airport before relying on them. De-icing not stated. Slot requests for commercial air transport go to Airport Coordination Limited (ACL). IATA code not stated in the AIP.
